final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.dealedge AS side, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY o.dealedge), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.side AS side, s1.cnt AS cnt, s1.cnt - s2.a AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.cnt > s2.a) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(diff) FROM s3
